module_summary: Bridges the PicoRV32 native memory interface to AXI4-lite by deriving per-channel valids from mem_valid/mem_wstrb, latching per-channel acknowledgements until transfer completion.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Native request valid; drives all AXI valids and ready signals

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Native completion from AXI bvalid or rvalid

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Native address forwarded to both AXI awaddr and araddr

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Write strobes choose write channels versus read channel

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Native write data forwarded to AXI wdata

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Native read data taken from AXI rdata

anchors.name: mem_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid, suppressed after ack_awvalid

anchors.name: mem_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-data valid, suppressed after ack_wvalid

anchors.name: mem_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid, suppressed after ack_arvalid

anchors.name: xfer_done
anchors.why: Registered transfer completion clearing all channel ack flags

anchors.name: ack_awvalid
anchors.why: Records write-address handshake done, blocks reissue of awvalid

anchors.name: ack_wvalid
anchors.why: Records write-data handshake done, blocks reissue of wvalid

anchors.name: ack_arvalid
anchors.why: Records read-address handshake done, blocks reissue of arvalid

anchors.name: mem_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response valid completing native write

anchors.name: mem_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read data valid completing native read

groups.name: Channel handshake tracking
groups.description: Ack flags per AXI channel cleared on transfer completion

groups.name: AXI request generation
groups.description: Derives AXI aw/w/ar requests and readies from native request

groups.name: Native memory port
groups.description: Native request, completion and data paths mapped onto AXI
